title: Anku
extract:

Acquisition
The Anku's blueprint can be researched from the Tenno Lab in the dojo.

This weapon can be sold for  5,000.

Notes

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Anku Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Anku with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Anku Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 70  Ueymag, and 300  Ariette Scale.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by building Melee Combo to 6x, then using a Heavy Attack. Once activated, the Incarnon form lasts for 180 seconds.
Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, Incarnon Form is removed upon death.

Evolutions

Trivia
The Anku's design is inspired by the  Paris, in the same manner that the  Redeemer ,  Dual Raza and  Boltace are based off the designs of the  Tigris,  Soma and  Boltor respectively.
The Anku is the first scythe that is built in the Clan Dojo.
When it was initially released, the Anku had a  stance polarity, which did not match either stances available at the time. This was later corrected in Hotfix 16.7.1 (2015-06-04), giving the Anku its current  stance polarity.
The Anku's blade folds down into the handle when stowed away.
The Anku's name is likely a reference to two words;
Anku is the Quechuan word for flexible or elastic, which likely refers to the three strings that retract the Anku's blade when it is holstered.
Ankou is a personification of death in Breton and French folklore. He is usually depicted as a skeleton wearing a cloak and a large-brimmed hat, along with wielding a scythe.
